# Method ImportLocalizations

#### ImportLocalizations(string, string, Dictionary<string, string>)

Imports all localization files (.TopDic or .xliff) contained into given directory.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 19, 55, 0)]
void ImportLocalizations(string inDirectoryPath, string inFileExtension, Dictionary<string, string> ioErrorMessages)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  string |  inDirectoryPath |  Directory path.  |  
 
|  string |  inFileExtension |  File extension (must be .TopDic or .xliff).  |  
 
|  Dictionary<string, string> |  ioErrorMessages |  Error messages.  |
